title: City Bridge Foundation — Climate & Environmental Justice (Round One)
description: Five-year core grants for community-led organisations working with Londoners most affected by climate-related harm and environmental challenges, through place-based resilience, community organising and influence, or storytelling and narrative change. £5.6m available in Round One.
who_can_apply: UK-registered charities, CIOs, charitable companies limited by guarantee, registered charitable industrial and provident societies, charitable community benefit societies, CICs, and constituted voluntary organisations with a fiscal host. Work must benefit people living in London's 32 boroughs or the City of London. Annual income must be between £50,000 and £1.5m.
what_they_fund: Core five-year grants of £125,000 to £450,000 for community-led climate and environmental justice work in Greater London. Excludes individuals, schools and statutory bodies, political parties, organisations without community leadership, work treating climate as a purely technical issue, and one-off or short-term projects without a systems-change focus.
source_note: Staged 2026-08-17 from Paul's spot check. Deadline quoted verbatim from the funder's page: '12 noon on Tuesday, 8 September 2026'. Income band 50k-1.5m is stated as an exclusion on the same page and needs structuring into min_org_income / max_org_income at review.
